# Audio Switch — Complete Technical Reference (v1.2.0)

URL: https://audio-switch.vercel.app
Direct Windows Installer (`AudioSwitch-Setup.exe`): https://audio-switch.vercel.app/download
Portable Executable (`AudioSwitch.exe`): https://audio-switch.vercel.app/portable
SHA-256 (`AudioSwitch-Setup.exe`): 16474956AD06B0215BC462B6F8302AE2B318D4138BD3D97003D233DB58FEDA43

## Summary
Audio Switch solves five common Windows 10/11 desktop audio problems in a single native C# / WPF single-file executable (`net8.0-windows10.0.19041.0`, self-contained x64, zero `.NET` runtime prerequisites):
1. Fast switching between 3.5mm AUX headphones, Bluetooth headsets, speakers, and microphones without opening Windows Sound Settings.
2. Per-app split audio routing (`Apps` tab & 1-click Dual Split) via Windows `AudioPolicyConfig` + `IAudioSessionManager2`: play music (Spotify, Chrome, Brave, Edge) through wired AUX while Discord / Teams / Zoom voice calls and headset microphone use Bluetooth simultaneously.
3. Playing audio to wired AUX headphones/speakers and Bluetooth headphones simultaneously while compensating for Bluetooth A2DP latency (`0–350 ms` circular FIFO buffer in user-mode WASAPI loopback).
4. Providing an iOS-inspired Dynamic Island floating at the top edge of the active screen: rests unobtrusively (`~0%` CPU, all background samplers and timers stopped) with event-driven `HWND_TOPMOST` / `Win+D` / display-shift persistence, reveals a rounded capsule on hover, and expands when clicked with horizontal click-and-drag sliding across three views: Audio (`Outputs | Microphones | Apps`), Spotify / YouTube Music Media (with auto-launch on Play and hidden tray mode off the taskbar), and Battery/System.
5. Showing connected-only Bluetooth headset battery percentages (`DEVPKEY_Device_IsConnected`) alongside laptop charge, RAM, CPU, and clock.

## Installation & Removal
- Per-user install location: `%LocalAppData%\Programs\AudioSwitch\AudioSwitch.exe` (no UAC admin prompt required).
- Includes Start Menu shortcut, optional Desktop shortcut, optional Run-on-Windows-Startup registry entry (`HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run`), and native Windows Settings -> Installed Apps uninstaller (`AudioSwitch.exe --uninstall`).

## Frequently Asked Questions
- How do I play audio on Bluetooth and AUX wired headphones at the same time in Windows 11 without echo?
  Audio Switch uses WASAPI loopback capture on the primary endpoint and feeds checked secondary endpoints through a ring-buffered `0–350 ms` sync delay slider (`170 ms` default) so wired AUX output waits for Bluetooth wireless latency.
- Does Audio Switch need .NET or virtual audio cables like VB-Cable installed separately?
  No. The installer bundles the .NET 8 desktop runtime and native WPF libraries inside one `74.4 MB` self-contained binary and uses native Windows Core Audio APIs rather than virtual audio drivers.
- How much CPU does Audio Switch use in the background?
  At rest, timers and WASAPI peak meters are completely stopped (`~0%` steady CPU; measured `0.047s` CPU over 6 wall-clock seconds).
